tree_structure.component_argument: After deleting s from a tree, each resulting component has exactly one neighbor of s; after also deleting the leaf v, these component roots are precisely the vertices W=N(s)\{v}.
tree_structure.rooted_factorization: For each rooted component H_i at w_i, A_i=I(H_i)=B_i+z I(H_i-N[w_i]), B_i=I(H_i-w_i); hence I(H)=product_i A_i and I(R)=product_i B_i.
tree_structure.same_support_tags: Leaves sharing a support have isomorphic deletion pairs and equal Delta_p(T-v), hence the strict selector includes all such leaves or none; the sum counts each selected leaf tag.
